_purpose: The declared arms of the comparison. This file is inside the net's source fingerprint, so adding, removing or repointing an arm re-arms the regression net — 'a model swap is a code deployment and should be treated as such'. The engine's own NET_MODEL env var is not used here: a five-arm benchmark has no single model id.

_frozen_skill.note: Local copy, ahead of the published lq-skills v1.0.0/v1.1.1. Alexios's Gate 1 ruling: ships in the repo in full, and is pushed upstream with a WHY-v1.5.0.md — his attestation, not the model's.

arms.constraint: 200k context ceiling — every other arm is 1M. The ICC case is ~230k tokens of documents, so this arm's eligibility depends on the retrieval-vs-inline decision. Report as a finding, never silently truncate.

arms.rate_note: UNPRICED — Google's published rate must be confirmed before any cost figure is reported. The gateway writes NULL for an unpriced pair by design (lq-ai CLAUDE.md: 'we don't invent prices'); an unpriced arm shows as unpriced, never as zero.
arms.reached_via: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai (OpenAI-compatible shim) — provider type 'openai', config only, no gateway adapter code
arms.cost_trap: The shim omits thinking tokens from completion_tokens (measured: completion_tokens 1 vs total_tokens 92 on a one-word reply). Bill output as total_tokens - prompt_tokens, or use the native endpoint's usageMetadata.thoughtsTokenCount. Billing off completion_tokens understates this arm by roughly 50x.
arms.stability: PREVIEW model id — may change behaviour or disappear under the same name. The report pins it and says so.

arms.privilege: FULLY ON-PREMISES — nothing leaves the machine. The only arm on which the skill's own privilege banner is satisfied without seat rules, party agreement and client consent.
arms.rate_note: No per-token price exists. Cost is electricity: wall-clock x measured package power (macmon) x tariff. The method is stated wherever the number appears.
arms.endpoint_note: Ollama binds this host's Tailscale address, NOT localhost — 127.0.0.1:11434 is refused. Several other projects still carry the stale localhost value.
arms.constraint: Reasoning-first: emits reasoning before content, so max_tokens >= 16000 or the answer comes back empty with finish_reason 'length'.

no_pass_bars.wording: Just explain the score, and score them. No need to attach an idea to a number. Just tell the truth and stay objective, no need to say who failed who didn't fail, let the reader decide.
no_pass_bars.consequence: NET.json tiers carry NO authored threshold. Regression is detected by the blessed baseline only — 'below what we last measured and Alexios blessed' — which is grounded in measurement rather than opinion. The publication reports raw ranked numbers and no pass/fail language.
